title: Pav Bhaji
howToPrepare:
Ingredients

    3 Potatoes peeled
 
    1 cup Green peas

    ½ cup Carrot
 
    ½ teaspoon Turmeric powder

    ½ tsp red chili powder

    1 tspSalt

    ½ tspWater

    3-4 tbsp butter

    1 Onion: 1  finely chopped

    1 tspGinger-garlic paste

    2-4 Green chilies

    2  finely chopped Tomatoes

      Instruction

    Place all vegtables into the pressure cooker

    Add salt and red chilli required to your taste

   Close the lid and keep on low heat till 4-5 whistles

   Open the lid and grab a smasher to smash the vegtables

   Heat a wide pan or tawa over medium flame

   Add 1 tbsp of oil and 2 tbsp of butter

   Add the chopped onions and sauté for 2-3 minutes until they turn translucent

   Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and chopped green chilies, frying for another 2 minutes until the raw smell vanishe

   Add the chopped tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook for 6-8 minutes until the tomatoes turn completely mushy and release oil/butter from the sides

   Reduce the heat and then pour the mashed vegetable mixture and mix well. Cook for 2 minutes.

   Let it simmer on medium-low heat for 5-7 minutes

   Taste and adjust the salt, then add lemon juice

   For the Pav toast as many as you need

   Enjoy!
